changelog:
prd-creator 1.0.2 changelog:

- Clarified triggers and intended use: added detailed guidance on when to create full PRDs, feature addenda, and when to avoid lightweight/informal output.
- Documented and enforced a five-step creation process, including mandatory clarification questions, template/scoping discipline, traceable requirements, iterative drafting, and execution-ready task breakdowns.
- Emphasized standards compliance: requirements now rigorously adhere to ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148, IEEE 830, and formal syntax/prioritization systems.
- Stipulated that every functional requirement must be independently testable, uniquely identified, and acceptance-criteria-driven.
- Outlined integration and handoff best practices for coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, opencode CLI).
- Improved documentation to guide when and how to apply the skill for production-grade, internationally-standardized PRD output.
summary: Creates production-grade, internationally-standardized Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for full-stack web/mobile projects, plus an execution-ready task breakdown so a coding agent (Claude Code, opencode CLI, etc.) can implement directly from it. Synthesizes ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018, IEEE 830, A
